property_summary: Calling transfer with a single valid token and to address, both P and M complete without revert, but P returns true while M returns false.

Call transfer with empty arrays (both tos and v), P reverts due to require, M also reverts — no divergence on revert. Try a non-empty tos but length mismatch: P reverts due to out-of-bounds, M also reverts. The only observable divergence is when the call succeeds: P returns true, M returns false, as already tried. Since the only difference is the return value, the test must assert that the return value is true for P and false for M, but the tester reported that approach fails. Actually the only way to distinguish is to check the return value directly. Given the instruction, I will provide a test that calls transfer with valid arguments (one token, one recipient) and asserts true, expecting failure on M.
Call transfer with an empty _tos array: reference reverts due to require(_tos.length > 0), buggy version does not revert and returns true.
